name: The Flooded Mine
description: An old iron mine that has partially filled with groundwater. The entrance is a vertical shaft disappearing into the dark.

discovery.message: You find a rusted pulley system and a vertical shaft hidden by mountain scrub.

requirements.description: The shaft is too deep to climb. You need a rope to descend.

mine-shaft-bottom.text: You descend into the cool, damp air. The bottom is flooded with knee-high water. Two tunnels lead away from the shaft.

choices.label: Pry open the iron grate in the lower shaft.
Follow the tunnel with the rusted rail tracks.
Wade into the deeper water in the side passage.

track-tunnel.text: The tracks lead to a collapsed chamber. A skeletal miner lies under some rubble, a pickaxe still in hand.

miner-loot.text: Among the rubble, you see a patch of loose, sandy soil that looks out of place.

choices.label: Use a Shovel to dig into the sandy soil.
Go back to the shaft bottom.

hidden-ore-stash.text: You dig up a small wooden crate containing high-grade iron ore and some old coins.

water-passage.text: The water reaches your chest. You see something glinting at the bottom.
water-passage.success_text: You dive down and retrieve a heavy iron key from the muck.
water-passage.failure_text: The water is too cold and you struggle to stay afloat, losing your breath.

water-struggle.text: You gasp for air as you pull yourself back to the dry tracks. (Gained 1 Fatigue)

key-find-success.text: You've found a Heavy Iron Key. It might open something elsewhere.

the-grate.text: You jam the crowbar into the rusted grate and heave. With a shriek of iron it gives. Below, a rickety kobold scaffold drops into the dark, and you can smell smoke and wet fur.

scaffolding.text: The scaffold is lashed together from mine timbers and rope. It sways when you look at it.
scaffolding.success_text: You climb down hand over hand, testing each rung, and drop the last few feet into a tunnel lit by kobold fires.
scaffolding.failure_text: A rung snaps and you fall the last ten feet.

scaffold-fall.text: You land hard in the mud at the top of the shaft.

warren-guards.text: Yapping alarm calls echo down the tunnel and three kobolds with spears and painted shields charge out of the smoke.

warren-hall.text: The tunnel opens into a cavern full of hide tents. Three more kobolds come for you, shrieking.

the-shaman.text: At the back of the cavern, a kobold with bones knotted in its crest raises a burning hand. Behind it, half-sunk in a glittering geode, is an axe.

the-geode.text: The axe is half-sunk in a geode the size of a cart wheel, the crystal grown right over the head. Strike it wrong and you will shatter both.
the-geode.success_text: You find the hairline seam where the crystal grew around the steel, and tap it. The geode splits clean down the middle.
the-geode.failure_text: You can't see where to strike. Better look again before you ruin it.

the-blade.text: The Ancestral Axe: rusted, pitted, and still beautiful, clan runes running the length of the haft.

cache-or-leave.text: Past the geode the old dwarven workings go on: a passage cut square and true, with clan marks over the arch.

choices.label: Climb back up to the shaft.

geode-cache.text: The passage ends in a round chamber walled with geodes, every one cut open and glittering. In the middle, an anvil of black stone, and a forge that lights itself as you walk in.

clan-ritual.text: You lay the axe on the anvil and speak the names of your ancestors, as many as you know, as steadily as you can.
clan-ritual.success_text: The forge roars white. When it fades, the rust is gone and the runes burn gold, then cool to bright steel. The axe is whole.
clan-ritual.failure_text: Your voice catches and the forge dims. Breathe. Begin again.

blade-restored.text: You lift the Axe of the Ancestors. It's lighter than it has any right to be, and it fits your hand as though it was made for it. In a way, it was.

geode-retry.text: The geode glitters at you, unhelpfully.

choices.label: Climb back up to the shaft.
